title: The Vision of the Four Chariots
description: Zechariah lifts his eyes and sees four chariots coming out from between two mountains of bronze: the first with red horses, the second with black, the third with white, and the fourth with spotted, strong horses. The angel explains that these are the four winds of heaven going out from the Lord of all the earth. The black ones go to the land in the north, with the white following after them; the spotted ones go toward the south, and the strong ones walk back and forth on the earth. Finally, the Lord says that those who went to the north have brought his Spirit to rest in the land in the north [ref:Zech 6:1-8|Zechariah 6:1-8].
